svg.title: Where the code is, by pipeline stage
svg.desc: Lines of C++ per stage. Inside the scheduler package almost everything is task planning; the motion planner's size is in the motion_planner package, most of which the scheduler uses; the action graph is small.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: solid: scheduler package pale, dashed outline: library package

g.text: Scheduler (main at a468657f): src/*.cpp without the ROS node (3,799 lines), counted by stage file: job expansion = job_expansion.cpp with bay_rebalancing.cpp and move_events.cpp; PlanMotions and its cost-audit log are counted out of scheduler.cpp,

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: whose rest, with utils.cpp, is the orchestrator. Libraries: every .hpp and .cpp in the motion_planner, planner_core and cost_functions snapshots; 'never called' = no call path from the scheduler's code (found by tracing calls from its sources). Not counted:

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: headers, task_planner (BottleneckAssignment, not in the snapshots), common_ros (the garage model, about 9,800 lines, used by every stage) and tests (about 3,660 lines of C++ in scheduler plus 130 scenario and initial-state YAML files).

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Lines of C++ (sources, without tests). In the scheduler package, task planning is about 2,770 of 3,800 lines (73%), the motion-planning adapter 45, the action graph about 570. Counting the library code the scheduler

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: actually calls, task planning is about 4,160 lines and motion planning about 3,900; about 660 lines of motion_planner are never called. The action graph stays small.
